games.title: Egg Jump
games.how: Pick an egg and run through the meadow! Tap to jump, tap again in the air to double jump. Hop over cactus, rocks and hedgehogs, stay low under birds, and collect stars.

games.title: Memory Match
games.how: Pick a theme — Animals, Fruits, Vehicles or Words — and flip two cards at a time to find the pairs. In Words, match each word with its picture! 3 levels, each bigger than the last.

games.title: Snake
games.how: Pick a snake and eat the fruit to grow! Swipe, use the arrow keys or the buttons to turn. Golden apples give +5 before they vanish. Don’t bump the fence, rocks or your own tail!

games.title: Whack-a-Mole
games.how: Pick Easy, Normal or Hard and bonk the moles as they pop up! Golden moles give +3, clocks give +3 seconds — but don’t bonk the bunny friends. 45 seconds on the clock!

games.title: Tic Tac Toe
games.how: Play X against the computer. Get 3 in a row to win!

games.title: Balloon Pop
games.how: Pick a sky and tap the balloons before they float away! Gold balloons give +5, hearts give an extra life, and animal riders parachute down. Don’t tap the bombs!

games.title: Fruit Catch
games.how: Pick an animal and catch the falling fruit in your basket! Drag or use the arrows to move. Honey pots give +5, 10 in a row doubles your points. Dodge the rocks and bees!

games.title: Simon Says
games.how: Watch the colors light up, then repeat the pattern. It gets longer every round!

games.title: Quick Math
games.how: Solve as many sums as you can in 60 seconds. Fast fingers, fast brain!

games.title: Flappy Bee
games.how: Pick a bee, bird, butterfly or ladybug and tap to flap! Fly through the gaps between the vines and sunflowers, and grab honey for +2. You hover until your first tap.

games.title: Brick Breaker
games.how: Pick a ball, drag the paddle and break all the candy bricks! Tap to launch. Catch power-ups: 🍄 big paddle, ⭐ extra balls, ❤️ extra life. Clear 5 picture levels!

games.title: Ping Pong
games.how: Pick an animal to play — Turtle is easy, Robo is a champion! Drag or use the arrows to move your paddle, and hit near the edge to aim. First to 7 points wins.

games.title: Slide Puzzle
games.how: Slide the tiles to put the numbers 1-8 back in order.

games.title: Rock Paper Scissors
games.how: Pick rock, paper, or scissors. First to beat the computer 5 times wins!

games.title: Odd One Out
games.how: One emoji is different from the rest. Find and tap it fast!

games.title: Color Tap
games.how: Tap the button matching the COLOR of the word, not the word itself. Tricky!

games.title: Number Rush
games.how: Tap the numbers 1 to 25 in order as fast as you can. Beat your best time!

games.title: Car Race 3D
games.how: Pick your car and race down a 3D road! Swipe or tap to change lanes. Grab coins and shields, and dodge cars, trucks and cones. It gets faster the longer you drive!
Swipe to slide tiles. Merge matching numbers to reach the legendary 2048 tile.

games.title: Tetris
games.how: Rotate and drop falling blocks to clear full lines. Speeds up as you level up!

games.title: Piano Tiles
games.how: Pick a song and tap the tiles as they reach the bottom — every tile plays the next note! Missing a tile or tapping empty space costs a heart. Finish the song and it plays again, faster.

games.title: Stack Tower
games.how: Tap to drop each moving block. Line it up perfectly to build the tallest tower.

games.title: Bubble Shooter
games.how: Aim and shoot bubbles to match 3+ colors and clear the board before it fills up.

games.title: Space Shooter
games.how: Pick a ship and drag to fly — it shoots by itself! Zap aliens and meteors, and beat the big UFO boss. Grab ⚡ triple shot, 🛡️ shield and ❤️ extra lives.

games.title: Sky Hopper
games.how: Pick a hopper and bounce up the clouds! Drag or use the arrows to steer — you can wrap around the sides. Mushroom clouds send you super high, grey clouds crumble. Grab stars and don’t fall!

games.title: Water Sort
games.how: Tap tubes to pour colors. Sort every liquid into its own tube to solve the puzzle.

games.title: Sling Blast
games.how: A funfair can toss! Drag back and let go to throw your ball — the dotted line shows where it goes. Knock every can off the shelves with 5 throws. Leftover throws give bonus points!

games.title: Connect Four
games.how: Drop discs to get 4 in a row before the computer does. Classic strategy showdown.

games.title: Sudoku Mini
games.how: Fill the 6x6 grid so every row, column, and box has numbers 1 through 6, no repeats.

games.title: Reaction Test
games.how: Wait for green, then tap as fast as you can. Track your reflexes over time!

games.title: Typing Speed
games.how: Type the sentence as fast and accurately as you can. Beat your best words-per-minute.

games.title: Jungle Runner 3D
games.how: Pick a runner and dash through the jungle! Swipe left or right to change lanes, up to jump over logs, and down to slide under branches. Collect fruit and grab the magnet!

games.title: Lane Hopper 3D
games.how: Pick an animal and hop across the farm! Tap or swipe up to hop. Dodge cars and trains, ride the logs across rivers, and grab corn. Keep moving — don’t wait too long!

games.title: Hoops 3D
games.how: Pick a ball and shoot hoops in a 3D arena! Drag and flick up to shoot — the dotted line helps you aim. Swish for 3 points and extra time. 3 in a row puts you ON FIRE!

games.title: Gravity Maze 3D
games.how: Pick a pet in a bubble ball and tilt the garden maze to roll it home! Drag anywhere or use the arrow keys. Collect 3 stars in each level, and watch out for holes from level 3. Clear all 6 levels!

games.title: Word Search
games.how: Drag across letters to find hidden words in the grid. Find all 8 words to win!

games.title: Spelling Bee
games.how: Look at the picture, tap 🔊 to hear it, then tap the letters to spell the word. Pick Easy (with hints), Jumbled, or Speed — spell as many as you can in 60 seconds!

games.title: Hangman
games.how: Guess the letters before you run out of tries! Solve 10 mystery words.

games.title: Missing Letter
games.how: A letter is missing from the word — pick the right one from 4 choices!

games.title: Rhyme Time
games.how: Pick the word that rhymes with the one shown. Ten rounds of rhyming fun!

games.title: First Letter Find
games.how: A letter is shown — tap the word from the options that starts with it!

games.title: Category Sort
games.how: Sort each word into the right bucket: Animals, Fruits, or Things!

games.title: Word Ladder
games.how: Change one letter at a time to climb the word ladder to the target word!

games.title: Synonym Match
games.how: Pick the word that means the same thing. Ten rounds of vocabulary fun!

games.title: Word Builder
games.how: Tap letters from the pool to build all the hidden words inside them!

games.title: Train the Robot
games.how: Answer questions to train NOVA the AI! Raise its IQ, fill the neural core and level it up. Wrong answers drain energy — keep it alive!

games.title: AI Quiz Master
games.how: 10 general-knowledge questions where the AI explains every answer. Chase streaks for bonus coins and a perfect score!

games.title: Hidden Objects
games.how: Study the cluttered desk scene and tap each object from the list where you spot it. Find them all fast — quick finds and unused hints score more!
